# Haunt

> GPS-triggered audio tours of haunted, true crime, and historical places. Narrated like a secret shared after midnight. Coming soon to iOS.

## What it is
Step near a place and its story finds you. No screens to consult. No maps to wrangle. Just the street, and a voice that's been here longer than the buildings. Walk or drive at your own pace; the stories pause when you do and resume when you move on.

## How it differs from existing audio-tour apps
- One narrator threads every city — calm, deliberate, unhurried — instead of a different guide per stop.
- No fixed route. No checkpoint pressure. Stories surface based on proximity, not a sequence.
- Three thematic layers (haunted, true crime, historical) intentionally chosen for after-dark walks rather than daytime sightseeing.
- Designed for self-paced exploration with headphones; not a group-tour replacement.

## Status
- Pre-launch. Email waitlist open via Kit.
- iOS app in development. No public release date.
- No Android version planned for initial launch.

## Cities targeted at launch
Los Angeles, New Orleans, Chicago, Boston, San Francisco, Savannah, Key West, plus more in development.

## Best experienced
After dark. Walking. With headphones. Solo or with one other person.
